name: mrunalnshah
bio: I read, code, listen, eat, and lose hours playing games. I'm the kind of person who gets obsessed with ideas, projects, late-night conversations, and anything that feels alive — anything with a little BANG! (qu)Bit, Atoms, Neurons, Genes Treks, cold winds, long roads, and snowy mountains are my system reboot. I'm spiritual but in my own way, and just a normal fedora user. Let's talk about "you"! but before that, let me finish myself.
currently: Master's student in Artificial Intelligence at Northeastern University, with a focus on working with messy data, semantic model building, and multimodal architectures spanning Computer Vision, NLP, and Reinforcement Learning.
Student Fellow at Northeastern's AI Makerspace, helping students across the university; work through their questions on AI, from first concepts to their own projects.

Recently completed an internship as an AI/ML Engineer Intern at Silver Touch Technologies, where I worked on AI models for user compliance and violation detection. During my bachelor's, I worked on computer vision for pneumonia detection from chest X-ray images and curated two datasets.

news.text: Started M.S. in AI at Northeastern University.
Completed my internship as AI/ML Engineer Intern at Silver Touch.
